title: Run Tactus tests against each Biblicus release candidate
description:
## Goal
Tactus pins `biblicus>=1.11.3,<2` and subclasses or calls `ContextAssembler`, `biblicus.context_engine.compaction`, `retrieve_context_pack`, `Corpus`, `build_plan_for_extract`, `build_plan_for_index`, and the text utilities. A Biblicus release can break it silently.

## Work
Add a release-workflow job that installs the release candidate into a checkout of AnthusAI/Tactus and runs its Biblicus-related tests (`tactus/core/retrieval.py`, `context_assembler.py`, `compaction.py`, `stdlib/biblicus`, and the `features/context_*` scenarios). It must block the publish step on failure. Document the stability promise for those modules in `docs/architecture.md`.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Done 2026-10-19: PR 76 merged to develop. tactus-compatibility.yml builds the candidate wheel, installs it over the published Biblicus in a Tactus checkout and runs the Biblicus-related Tactus tests; CI on PR 76 ran 170 pytest and 23 behave scenarios, all passing. release.yml runs it before semantic-release, so a failure creates no tag, no release notes and no PyPI package; ci.yml runs it on every push and PR. Stability promise documented in docs/architecture.md. Takes effect on releases once develop is promoted to main.
